catalog.title: Ingersoll Compact Tractors 2012 Parts Catalog 8-3220
catalog.structure: PDF p1 cover and alphabetical index, p2 general information and product identification numbers (printed p1), p3 paint and oil (left; Ingersoll back-cover logo on the right), p4-27 diagram/table spreads (printed pp5-51, tables on odd pages), p28-29 numerical index (printed pp52-54; the last half page is blank)

engines.appliesNote: all serials in this book (ID table: tractor model 2012 = engine C37031; a speck on the scan sits between the 7s of 260777). Single cylinder per the engine pages (one cylinder assembly, one cylinder head). Engine parts are listed under Ingersoll C numbers (three Briggs BR numbers: 221535, 221798, 270920).

editions.serialAsPrinted: No range on the cover or ID page and no serial or P.I.N. break in any table (confirmed by eye on all 24 table pages). The ID page carries only the stock note "In this catalog there are references to serial numbers. To order the correct part, use these serial numbers as a guide."; none are printed. The only split is by transaxle model (826 or 843) on the differential page, not by serial.

validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table page read by eye from 220-dpi crops of the table half of each spread (2 pages per image at 0.72x, doubtful cells and out-of-register REQ'D columns re-viewed at higher zoom); indentation measured from the description x-start of each row and checked by eye. Numerical index (printed pp52-54) read by eye in full at full resolution (8 crops), typed out and compared with the transcription in both directions on (part, page, ref); every difference re-checked on zoomed crops of the index and the table. Compared row by row with the 8-3210 file after the transcription was complete.
validation.refContinuity: All sections continuous except: hood ref 23 and electrical hardware ref 13 are not printed (index agrees); front axle prints ref 20 twice and no ref 21 (index agrees: 192-21 at 31/20). Repeated refs kept as printed (pistons 18 x2, 21 x4, ring sets 22 x4, push rods 36 x2, fuel tank brackets 10 x2, hood 16 x2, 20 x2 and 27 x2, front axle 20 x2, differential 4, 11 and 12 x2 each (double-D vs splined shafts), decals 1 x2). Cylinder block refs 28 and 31 both print C34616 (index agrees). 3 unnumbered rows kept with ref "" (carburetor C34630, starter C40798, headlight assembly C32178).
validation.quantities: Every row has a qty; 15 rows are UAR. REQ'D is printed half a row off register on the engine air baffles and exhaust system (printed p15): 27 qtys mapped in sequence and flagged inferred (the baffles page reads 1, UAR, 1, UAR, 1, 1, 1, 1, 4, 1). The gasket kit (p17) is in register.
validation.numericalIndex: 605 index entries (printed pp52-54; the last half page is blank) against 607 indexable rows (NSS rows and the paint and oil page are not indexed). 602 agree exactly. Differences: choke and throttle 19/1 (table C37095, index prints C37905 and has no C37095); PTO 23/46 (table C29243 GUIDE - belt; the index lists C29243 at 23/40, the position of C17066 WASHER - cup, and not at 23/46); table kept on both under the standing reading, each flagged and pending the user's confirmation. 3 table rows are not indexed (exhaust 15/16 C37108 and 15/17 C37200, hood 25/21 C31597; kept as printed, flagged). 1 index entry has no table row: C28962 at 47 with no ref (nothing to store; section note). The index prints C34630 (11), C40798 (17) and C32178 (47) with no ref, matching the three unnumbered rows. Hardware codes 13-628, 61-612 and 83-55 print with a leading zero in the index (stored as in the table).
validation.partNoForms: Ingersoll C numbers closed up (C34669); Briggs BR numbers stored bare (221535, 221798, 270920); hardware codes closed up (113-103, 187-1036, 321-6659, 353-462, 13-628, 61-612, 83-55); 61 NSS rows stored as NSS with source null (footnote text in the flags where printed); the transaxle +/++ marks and NSS* are removed from partNo and kept in partNoAsPrinted. Printed form kept in partNoAsPrinted.
validation.siblingCheck: Row-by-row against 8-3210 (same ref and part number, this book's rows): PTO 46/46, seat and fenders 21/21, steering 21/21, lift system 14/14, headlight 8/8, wheels 13/13, fuel system 16/17, front axle 21/22, hood 35/37, weight box 6/7; partly shared: belts 20/30, brake 17/25, electrical hardware 16/21, travel control 10/20, electrical 7/15, engine mounts 3/7, choke and throttle 2/4; decals 0/10 (2012 decals); engine sections differ completely (this single-cylinder C37031 vs the twin C33753: flywheel 0/31, ignition 0/14, block 0/40, base and oil filter 0/26, governor 0/31, air cleaner 0/10, baffles 0/10, gasket kit 0/16, exhaust 0/17, starter 1/12; carburetor 15/42 same ref and part). The 2014 hydrostatic transmission pages have no counterpart; this book has the C29241 5-speed transaxle in three tables.
